title: Dry run: shiftRight on [1, 2, 3, 4]

steps.note: Save the last element before it gets overwritten: end = arr[3] = 4.
The loop starts at i = 3 and walks right to left. 3 > 0 is true.
arr[3] = arr[2] = 3. The old 4 is overwritten, but it's safe because it's saved in end.
arr[1] = arr[0] = 1. Now indices 1..3 hold the shifted values.
i-- makes i = 0. 0 > 0 is false, so the loop ends. arr[0] still holds the old 1.
arr[0] = end = 4. The saved last element wraps around to the front.
Return [4, 1, 2, 3], which matches the expected output.
